protocol: Unchanged architecture/carrier/initial parameter banks, full432-image A1 and216-bond H. Reuse known64 controls/Jacobians and SEALED full energy gradients; no consumed audit read, fit extension or new head. Residual objective R=||(H-E)psi||^2/(N||psi||^2), complex finite-Q E, not bare H2. Complete residual and norm derivatives from the existing plan pullback: vectorize TWO cotangent RHS (half objective and full objective) on each physical plan; count derivative work separately. Sum full-objective partial gradients, never average half variance gradients incorrectly. Normalize six full/half E/N and R gradients by inverse SAME2FS+.1I metric norms before a predeclared minimax simplex/KKT solve; weights use gradients only. Final common direction is unit full-cache FS, not unit parameter norm. All parameters joint, include off-central-J row components and report them. Replay old JVP residual slopes, then a64-center new full-H JVP and one four-center actual-parameter FD for BOTH energy and R.
update_boundary: At mostONE candidate per arm only if all six JVP derivatives are strictly negative and motion nonzero. Match maximum ACTUAL nonlinear FS across full cache, two halves AND all8 individual chains to unchanged .01 using exactly13 amplitude probes; no post-outcome shrink or radius/damping sweep. Candidate full-H products must lower/nonworsen BOTH energy and residual moment on full cache AND both halves, with unchanged ESS/carrier-FS bounds. Residual ceiling1.0C replaces old1.1 because this task is JOINT descent; it is not relaxed. Fixed parent and failed candidates/checkpoints preserved. No size/ED/GPU change.
audit_boundary: Reuse tested Rayleigh finalizer. Only if a candidate passes cache checks, draw ONE fresh common128-record audit at2026100264. Evaluate ALL constructed candidates, including rejected controls. Commit only cache-passing candidates with BOTH nonworsening fresh point E and R, same ESS/carrier-FS and actual max audit-chain FS<=.01. Report paired95% intervals regardless of point acceptance. Audit used for acceptance, NOT gradients, explicitly consumed with no refit. Otherwise endpoint is EXACT original carrier. Point gates are not a PRL variational certificate.
cost_boundary: No new training samples. Per arm64 physical pullback-plan centers with TWO cotangents (128 scalar-adjoint center equivalents),64 primal+tangent JVP centers,8 ordinary FD H centers, at most64 candidate-H centers,13 amplitude-only probes. Across2 arms derivative work256 adjoint equivalents+128 JVP, ordinary FD16+candidate<=128. Conditional fresh audit128 records and at most256 residual forward-H centers, reference-bank and analytic-carrier work also reported.1800s/8GiB per process; no continuation or production release.
